results.category: Mandatory Scenario 1: Rapid Double-Click & Repeated Submission
results.failure_reason: PostgreSQL unique constraint uq_idemp_key_actor_op permitted duplicate keys when actor_id IS NULL, completely bypassing guest idempotency.
results.fix_applied: Created partial unique index uq_idemp_key_null_actor_op on (key, operation) WHERE actor_id IS NULL in migration g1_idempotency_guard.
results.evidence: 2 idempotency records originally created; now exactly 1 created, concurrent request replayed.

results.category: Mandatory Scenario 1: Rapid Double-Click & Repeated Submission
results.failure_reason: Guest sequential retry did not match existing key due to NULL actor_id, re-attempted hold and failed with 409 'Slot unavailable'.
results.fix_applied: Partial unique index uq_idemp_key_null_actor_op forces IntegrityError on replay, triggering safe response retrieval from idempotency cache.
results.evidence: Original response replayed with identical booking_id and status 201.

results.test_name: frontend/src/components/ReviewPay.test.tsx::rapid double click triggers onSubmitBooking only once and attaches idempotencyKey
results.category: Mandatory Scenario 1: Rapid Double-Click UI Guard
results.failure_reason: ReviewPay.tsx lacked synchronous submission lock and never attached Idempotency-Key header to booking requests.
results.fix_applied: Added submittingRef synchronous guard in ReviewPay.tsx and wired stable UUID Idempotency-Key through bookingsApi.create.
results.evidence: Triple click invokes onSubmitBooking exactly once with generated idempotencyKey string.

results.category: Mandatory Scenario 2: Network Timeout After Server Success
results.failure_reason: Client simulated dropped connection; retry without partial index threw 409 slot conflict instead of returning existing held reservation.
results.fix_applied: Idempotent response retrieval unblocks on existing committed key, replaying original 201 BookingCreateResponse.

results.category: Mandatory Scenario 3: Concurrent Requests for Same Operation
results.failure_reason: process_booking_action_request queried BookingActionRequest without with_for_update(); concurrent approvals both executed and doubled refunds.
results.fix_applied: Added with_for_update(of=BookingActionRequest) to serialize action processing.
results.evidence: Both approvals originally succeeded with 2 refunds in DB; post-fix exactly 1 succeeds, second gets 409, exactly 1 refund in DB.

results.category: Mandatory Scenario 3: Concurrent Requests for Same Operation
results.failure_reason: Concurrent signup requests both passed time-of-check query; second request crashed with unhandled 500 DB IntegrityError.
results.fix_applied: Wrapped signup transaction in try/except IntegrityError and returned standard 409 Conflict.
